name: Timnath
overview: Timnath is a biblical location associated with significant narrative moments, particularly in the lives of Judah and Samson. Genesis 38 records Judah going to Timnath during a time of personal mourning, highlighting the town as a place of daily life and social interaction. Judges 14 reveals Timnath as the home of Samson's Philistine wife, marking it as a setting of pivotal events in Samson's story. Some authorities believe Timnath to be identical with Timnah, underscoring its importance in the biblical record.
